title: Complete source-array backing at selected ADD callback boundaries
body:
The actual ADD coefficient boundary needs a complete backing bill: a child callback keeps the parent callback tapes, an extended Program and the leaf callback alive together, while numerical arena high water persists across traversal cuts. This package supplies the conditional source-array bound `K0+A` for the unchanged `Consumer.apply` coefficient closure → `stream_runner.action` → `add_pass`, including extent preparation, payload, count tapes, warm slots and all serialized record categories.

The real final-width64 plan/trace binds a packet of `9^128` bits symbolically. The finite calibration separately executes two real coefficient calls per complete81-bit component ADD, including cold, warm and actual child requests. Observed peaks are278002,355856 and190878 source cells; child record peak607 rejects both the four-stack-only bill and the bill omitting its extended Program. A one-cell-short observer quota also rejects. The width64 fixture repairs the predecessor fixture's width256 entry mismatch without modifying frozen runtime sources.

Validation: registered Python3.12 normal/optimized replay, independent source/proof review, committed-byte and source-history checks, official40-file export integrity, and Git-free optimized cold replay passed. Missing and changed source controls reject; all exported bytes were restored unchanged. Export SHA256: `c58d5af04dbddeda027f181949987cd622f342bb922bfe601b8a87a4002a2374`.

This is a written conditional source-backing refinement with finite corroboration, not a physical tape supplier, execution of the entire Consumer/full packet, selected-catalogue admission, whole recursive reserve, H2/P3/outer admission or a new multiplication bound. Open obligations are physical placement/movement/erasure and composition with whole-caller/recursive residents. Original Jose Manuel, Nick Petalas, kumagi and other predecessor attribution and exact retained-source hashes remain in the package.
